note: 16 macros per die: 1160 CIM dies on a 35x35 mesh, central digital unit, mesh 0.4 GB/s
precision: CIM: 8-bit weights and activations, 2-byte partial sums, 16-bit digital intermediates; K/V cache 2 bytes per element (as the GPU baselines' 16-bit cache)
fixed_mapping: the representative search layout of the record (prefill, 512 tokens), used for every forward of the request

sources.cim_device: NeuRRAM-class RRAM macro (Wan et al., Nature 2022), CiMLoop calibration; 10.14 us per input row
sources.digital_unit: central digital unit: 2 TMAC/s, 1 pJ per MAC-equivalent operation, K/V memory 2 GB at 25.6 GB/s (LPDDR4, two 32-bit channels), 12.5 GB/s hub interface (one Simba GRS transceiver), 8 MB working buffer
sources.mesh: 0.4 GB/s per direction per link (HERMES-class analog-chip link rate, 3.2 Gbit/s), die ports at kappa = 2
